title: Protests over living costs and clashes in Milan
seoTitle: Milan protest over cost of living

tea.why: Protesters demonstrated over soaring living costs and unaffordable housing in Milan.
tea.want: Demonstrators marched to express economic discontent and living cost concerns.
tea.changed: Oct 24: Police conducted raids on homes of riot suspects and the government deployed 500 troops.

summary: Hundreds of young people marched in Milan to protest soaring living costs and unaffordable housing. According to reports, the atmosphere was initially peaceful until police blocked access near Piazza del Duomo, after which clashes erupted with officers deploying tear gas. Concurrently, groups engaged in vandalism and looting across the city centre. Retail association Confcommercio stated the unrest caused around a billion euros in damage. In response to the events, Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni’s government enacted security measures, including deploying 500 troops to Milan, passing new decrees targeting juvenile delinquency, holding parents financially accountable, and increasing police powers.
response: According to reports, the government deployed 500 troops to Milan, enacted new security measures, increased police powers, and targeted juvenile delinquency by holding parents accountable and expanding detention facilities.

arrests.text: Over 270 people were detained and 32 were arrested.

updates.text: Protesters marched through Milan over living costs before clashes and vandalism occurred.
Police conducted home raids on approximately 100 suspects across multiple cities following the Milan unrest.
